Interface VirtualView

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient, SocketClient, SocketClientHandler
public interface VirtualView extends Remote
This interface defines the methods for client-side display and input operations that can be remotely invoked by the server. It represents a generic view accessible by the server, allowing different underlying communication technologies (RMI, Socket) to implement it.

Methods declared in this interface are expected to throw Exception to signal any issues that prevent the successful completion of the operation. These exceptions can arise from low-level network communication failures or from application-level logical errors encountered during the display or processing of the information on the client.
